label: GO step choosing a1 right after a rewarded trial (early-to-mid episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew was 1 at D1; 100% of mass), and almost only when the agent picks a1 (model_act==1 holds 99% of mass, a2 about 1%). The policy logit is strongly toward a1 (choice > 8.07 holds 82% of mass), and value is in its upper-middle range. There is a strong episode-time effect: the rate is highest in trials 0-30, falls off from trials 40-60, and is zero after trial 80. It never fires on the first 2 episode trials. Adding ep_trial < 60 raises dev F1 from 0.44 to 0.62 while keeping 98% of mass. Magnitude: biggest when the reward came after a rare transition into S2 (e.g. a1 then S2 rare then rewarded), and it decays over runs of consecutive common rewarded a1 trials (0.37, 0.25, 0.0). Trying to capture this with reward-history clauses lowered F1, so precision stays limited: many rewarded a1 GO steps early in the episode are silent. It does not fire at D1 or D2, after unrewarded trials, or when choosing a2. Recorded predicate uses only observed or computed variables (model_act is the agent own choice at GO).
